### E&F Currency Merge -- GENERATED FILE, DO NOT EDIT
### Rebuild with tools/regen_ef_currency_merge.py after any E&F or hotfix update.
###
### Source: the 95 currencies E&F declares production methods for.
###
### Prestige goods do not count against the 128-goods ceiling -- measured, not
### assumed: 100 dummies on one base good load fine. So the currencies come back
### as prestige variants of the one shared good, with their own names, their own
### icons, a prestige bonus and the engine's +20% throughput for buildings that
### consume them.
###
### Produced only by a company that owns a building making the base good -- which
### is why building_bank has to be ownable and has to be in the bank companies'
### building_types. See zz_ef_cm_bank.txt and zz_ef_cm_companies.txt.
